audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart (phases[0..3].side='Pyke', phases[4].side='Skill', phases[5].side='Skill') disagreed with the content layer (win[0..3]='Skill', win[4]='Neeko', win[5]='Pyke'). Content's whys[] are specific and grounded (Bone Skewer angle, Pop Blossom flipping the dive-reset, W roam-reset lethality snowball); full's phases[].why were flat template lines ('Q-bloom the pair — bot's formations eat the triple pop beautifully') that don't reference this matchup at all.
audit.why: The chart rule requires side+why to move together and to agree with win[N]. Content was clearly the correct, kit-grounded version, so full was moved to match it rather than the reverse.
audit.corrected: phases[0-3].side -> Skill, phases[4].side -> Neeko, phases[5].side -> Pyke, with matching .why text grounded in the content whys[]. phases[6] already agreed (Skill/Skill) and was left alone.

audit.why: Content spikes[] already correctly identify level 2 (mutual setup dependency), level 6 (Pop Blossom flips Death From Below dive), and first item (Pyke's lethality/roam snowball) as the real spikes.

audit.why: Both are real kit facts (enemyKit.P.flags.percentHealth, enemyKit.W.flags.stealth) directly relevant to itemization and vision calls in this matchup.

edits.after: Q zone and hook threat cancel — neither commits; stand behind minions.

edits.after: Both spike at 2 but need setup — deny his straight-line Skewer angle.

edits.before: E threats live: the root into bloom chunks; pick one window per wave.

edits.after: Pop Blossom flips his dive-reset: bait Death From Below, pop the AoE stun.

edits.before: E the cover-line, Q the rooted pile, auto the passive — the lane's longest pick paid in pairs.

edits.before: Q-poking with the E banked forever — the root is the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Shapesplitter banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Pyke's Bone Skewer (Q) is down 10s early, 8s at max rank — his R Death From Below cleans what it catches. - Keep W Shapesplitter banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Skip raw armour stacking — his P converts bonus HP to AD, not the other way, so it doesn't blunt him.
